title: Proof of Purchase and Refund Tender Standards, Northgate Store and Online Orders
content:
Proofs of purchase, returns without a receipt and refund tenders for **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, per fulfilment program.

| Program | Proofs of purchase accepted as a receipt | Returns without a receipt accepted (in store, with photo ID) | Refund price without a receipt | Tender for a refund without a receipt | Most returns without a receipt per customer in any rolling 45 days | Most refunded without a receipt per customer in any rolling 45 days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Store Purchase | printed receipt, e-receipt, card lookup | yes | the lowest selling price of the last 90 days | merchandise return card | 3 | 150.00 |
| Northgate Order Pickup | order number, e-receipt | no | not applicable | not applicable | 0 | 0.00 |
| Northgate Drive Up | order number, e-receipt | no | not applicable | not applicable | 0 | 0.00 |
| Northgate Ship to Home | order number, e-receipt | no | not applicable | not applicable | 0 | 0.00 |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery | order number, e-receipt | no | not applicable | not applicable | 0 | 0.00 |
| Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery | order number, e-receipt, printed receipt | no | not applicable | not applicable | 0 | 0.00 |

Values in US dollars where an amount is shown.

**Common to every program.**
- Tender for a refund on a gift receipt: a merchandise return card.
- How a refund with a receipt is paid: to the original payment method (original tender), Northgate Cash and gift card portions first back to the same tender.
- Rounding applied to each refund line: rounded half up to the cent.

**Points of judgement (hypothetical).** In the one program that accepts returns without a receipt, a customer with 3 such returns in the rolling 45 days has reached the count; a customer at 140.00 refunded without a receipt in that period cannot add a return that would take the total above 150.00.
